body: The wound is in action and assertion: a hurt around your right to want, push, or compete, so anger and initiative feel risky.
business: You help others reclaim their drive without guilt.
shadow: Blocked or overcorrected aggression, or turning the hurt into self-attack.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
